messages:
emily: Quick follow-up from the postmortem: last night's autoscale oscillation exposed three recurring gaps — quota headroom, prewarm cold-starts, and cron-batch collisions. We need concrete owners + timelines to avoid repeat. Who can take what?

nate: I can take prewarm/cold-starts. Idea: add a lightweight warmup pod per pool that keeps kernel/runtime caches hot. I'll prototype a k8s deployment that runs at 1% of capacity and measures startup time reduction. ETA: 2 weeks.

priya: I'll pick up quota headroom and the change control process. Action: file quota request + cost approval and add an emergency fast-path for on-call to request temporary burst capacity. Will draft the runbook by Thu.

oscar: I'll own cron-batch collisions. Observed pattern: many batch jobs converge at 09:00 UTC because of timezone-aligned schedules. Plan: enforce job jitter + add a queue weight limiter for big-gpu jobs. Will spin up a proposal doc and PoC in staging. ETA: next Tue.

emily: Nice. Also we saw scheduler backlog tied to GC pauses on older node images. Can we add a node-image upgrade tracker?

nate: Yep — I'll include node-image lifecycle in the prewarm plan. Also testing idea: simulate 20% node OOMs in staging to validate scheduler prioritization and preemption thresholds.

priya: For quota request, I'll use this template and attach cost delta: https://our-ops/wiki/quota-requests. Suggest bump of 25% for prod-eu reserved pool and 10% for prod-us while we validate autoscale fixes.

oscar: For throttling, propose a `batch_priority` label with values low/normal/high and a controller that enforces `max_running_per_pool`. Prototype config snippet: ```yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
data:
  max_running_high: "2"
  max_running_normal: "10"
```

ops-bot: Opened ticket CAPACITY-3091 for "Quota headroom and burst workflow" and linked to retrospective notes.

emily: Assigning deadlines: prewarm prototype (nate) 14 days; quota request + emergency runbook (priya) Thu EOD; batch jitter + controller PoC (oscar) Tue EOD. Check-in meeting scheduled Fri 09:30 UTC.

priya: Also adding an alert refinement: `gpu_reserved_utilization_5m` should alert at 85% (warn) and 95% (page). I'll post the Alertmanager patch in a bit.

nate: One more note — measure tail latency for small vs large models during spikes. If large-model tail dominates, we can route large-model traffic to dedicated pools as a mitigation.

emily: Good call. Add routing/segmentation as optional mitigation (secondary owner: platform team).

oscar: Adding JIRA CAPACITY-3092 for batch-windowing, will link once created.

sre-bot: Summarized owners and created follow-ups: CAPACITY-3091, CAPACITY-3092, CAPACITY-3093 (prewarm). Next check-in Fri 09:30 UTC. :white_check_mark:

emily: Thanks — I'll update the incident postmortem with owners, timelines, and these ticket links. If anyone hits blockers, drop them here or in the tickets. :rocket:
